'''Sesid''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sesid system/Legends|Sesid system]], and home to the [[Draedan/Legends|Draedan]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was run by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Arvel Trace]].
